# Make builtin PVM the default

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

The plan is to make 0.3.x series with Builtin PVM and `0.4.x` series with Ananas.

Also fix mistaken explicit dependency on `config` package.

## Walkthrough

This pull request modifies three components to align workspace dependency versioning and update a default PVM backend configuration. The .coderabbit.yaml file is updated to enforce wildcard version specifications for internal workspace dependencies. The `@typeberry/config` dependency in pvm-host-calls is updated from a caret constraint to wildcard, and the default PVM backend in node-config is changed from Ananas to BuiltIn.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

- The NODE_DEFAULTS pvm field change from PvmBackend.Ananas to PvmBackend.BuiltIn may require verification that this default change aligns with intended behavior and doesn't break existing configurations
- The wildcard versioning for `@typeberry/config` warrants confirmation that this version flexibility is intentional and won't introduce compatibility issues
